architecture_decisions: Keep python package path backend/autoclip; product identity centralised in autoclip/product.py.
One AI Manager: autoclip/intelligence/manager.py. Pipeline requests capabilities, never models.
One model registry: autoclip/intelligence/registry.py; defaults overridable via Settings.ai.
Provider HTTP logic stays in autoclip/providers/*. NVIDIA = OpenAI-compatible adapter; TypeSafe/Jev = httpx adapter against POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone (docs.typesafe.ai/api).
Decision capabilities (candidate_triage etc.) have two executions: Jev typed questions or LLM JSON; both normalise to the same internal result.
AI returns word indices / candidate ids only; Python resolves timestamps via boundaries.refine.
Global selection is deterministic greedy with explicit overlap/topic/type penalties; exact count owned by Python; deterministic sentence-window fallback fills gaps without duplicates.
Intelligence sub-steps write artifacts under work/{job}/intel/ so AI failures never force re-transcription.
Primary mobile path: Kaggle free-GPU notebook driven from phone browser. GitHub Actions rejected by user.
Stages: prepare, transcribe, highlights(=discovery), evaluate, select, reframe, captions, export. 'highlights' value kept for old job rows.
Job settings: creative sections from the job snapshot, provider/AI routing from current settings (fixes queue ignoring per-job overrides).
Selection hard constraint MAX_OVERLAP=0.15 of shorter clip; tiers: judged_keep +0.12, discovered -0.10, triaged -0.05, fallback -0.25, judged_reject -0.30.
